listing.title: My First Ocean Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Sea Animal Pages – Whale, Octopus, Crab, Sea Turtle & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book full of friendly sea animals!

Little hands color 30 smiling ocean friends and seaside things, from a whale and an octopus to a crab, a sea turtle and a starfish. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, so small hands can color inside the lines.

Inside you'll find:

  • Sea animals: Fish, Whale, Dolphin, Octopus, Crab, Sea Turtle, Starfish, Seahorse, Jellyfish, Shark, Clownfish, Pufferfish, Seal, Penguin, Lobster, Stingray, Walrus, Sea Otter and Narwhal
  • Under the sea: Clam & Pearl, Seashell, Coral and Seaweed
  • On the water and at the beach: Submarine, Sailboat, Anchor, Lighthouse, Treasure Chest, Sandcastle and Beach Bucket
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines, and each name in big letters to color
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
